title: Unpinned GitHub Actions tags in security-deep and ci workflows
description: Workflows checkout repositories or run actions without commit SHA pinning and trailing comments, violating the pinned-tag policy.
root_cause: .github/workflows/security-deep.yml and ci.yml use mutable action tags without full commit SHA pinning and documentation comments.
intended_behavior: All third-party actions in GitHub Actions workflows must be pinned to immutable 40-character commit SHAs with comments.

trace.description: Action reference uses mutable ref df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10 without tag comment.
Toolchain action dtolnay/rust-toolchain without trailing tag annotation.

evidence.description: Unannotated action commit hash in security-deep workflow.

conditions.description: Attacker compromises or replaces upstream action repository tags or branches.

execution.attacker_perspective: Upstream dependency maintainer or malicious actor modifying released tag.
payloads: Upstream tag modification or branch force-push.
instructions: Modify upstream git tag to point to malicious commit in third party action repository.
execution.observed_result: CI workflows execute untrusted code in runner context if tags are not verified.

remediation.strategy: Apply the pinned-tag skill scripts/resolve-action-sha.sh to pin all GitHub Actions to verified commit SHAs.

likelihood.reason: Requires upstream supply-chain compromise or non-immutable tag movement.

impact.reason: Allows unauthorized code execution in CI runner environment.

confidence.reason: Directly observable in workflow configuration files.

title: Known vulnerabilities in web dashboard devDependencies
description: Multiple npm dependencies in the development and dashboard dependency tree have reported vulnerabilities.
root_cause: Indirect dependencies (zod, re2js, glob, minimatch, katex) have unpatched or outdated versions in pnpm-lock.yaml.
intended_behavior: Dependencies should be updated to versions with resolved security advisories.

trace.description: Lockfile includes vulnerable versions identified by pnpm audit.
markdownlint-cli2 and dashboard dependencies pull affected packages.

evidence.description: pnpm audit reports 5 vulnerabilities: 2 high, 2 moderate, 1 low.

conditions.description: ReDoS payloads in markdown parsing or untrusted input passed to zod validation.

execution.attacker_perspective: Author of untrusted markdown input or hostile glob/regex expressions.
payloads: Pathological regex inputs triggering ReDoS in re2js or minimatch.
instructions: Provide crafted markdown files during linting.
execution.observed_result: Denial of service via CPU or memory exhaustion during development tool execution.

remediation.strategy: Update markdownlint-cli2 and run pnpm update to upgrade transitive dependencies.

likelihood.reason: Affects development tooling and build-time dependencies rather than production runtime.

impact.reason: Limited to development machine or CI pipeline denial of service.

confidence.reason: Confirmed by pnpm audit against npm advisory database.

title: CSRF bypass on management endpoints
description: Hypothesis that management endpoints could be modified without CSRF tokens.
claimed_root_cause: Missing CSRF verification on state-changing management API routes.

evidence.description: All state-changing management methods strictly enforce valid matching cookie and header tokens.

reason: CsrfGuard middleware enforces double-submit cookie token validation on all state-changing management routes.
